newsitem.title: UK: Gartland Whalley to float unit Aquarius.
newsitem.headline: Gartland Whalley to float unit Aquarius.

text.p: British industrial corporate developer Gartland Whalley & Barker (GWB) said on Thursday it issued the prospectus for the flotation of its unit Aquarius, which is seeking a full market listing.

GWB said the placing price of 166p per share gives Aquarius a market capitalisation of 34.2 million stg. It said the Aquarius flotation would raise 8.8 million stg which would replace debt with equity capital and to reduce borrowings.
GWB, which previously floated three companies, will hold 60 percent of Aquarius which will be valued at 20.6 million stg compared with investment cost of less than seven million stg.

Aquarius, an amagalmation of four businesses, designs and produces home improvement products. In the eight months to September 30 1996, Aquarius made pretax profit of 1.8 million on turnover of 18.8 million.
For the year ending in January 31 1997, GWB is forecasting profit before interest and tax for Aquarius of not less than 4.6 million stg.
